summary: Sun Communities Inc. filed an 8-K/A to amend its previous 8-K, disclosing the authorization of a $1 billion stock repurchase program effective May 27, 2026, and filing Exhibit 2.1 (a sale and purchase agreement from the original report). In this amendment, the registrant Sun Communities acts as issuer: its board authorized repurchases of up to $1 billion of its common stock over one year via open market, negotiated, or accelerated transactions under Rule 10b5-1 and Rule 10b-18. No price, premium, or specific terms are given; the program is discretionary and may be suspended anytime. The filing also supplements the original 8-K with Exhibit 2.1, but the core event is a routine capital allocation authorization, not a special situation. Watch for actual repurchase activity under market conditions.
